men.summary: At 1-0 with a home win and Big East play still to start, the Bluejays have almost no sample to judge, and the metrics conflict: a NET of 83 sits far from an RPI of 19, and the 4-6 last-10 mark can't come from a single game this season. With no Quadrant 1 games yet and a NET outside the usual at-large range, their postseason outlook is unsettled, and they will need a strong Big East run to build an NCAA tournament case.

women.summary: At 1-0 with a road win that counts as a Quadrant 1 victory, the Bluejays have started cleanly, though Big East play hasn't begun (0-0) and the listed 7-3 last-10 mark can't be reconciled with a one-game record, so I'd treat it as unreliable. With a NET ranking of 91 against an RPI of 29, their postseason outlook is still undefined: the early Q1 win helps, but they will need a strong conference run to move the NET into at-large range.
